title: LSASS Memory Access with Suspicious Granted Access Rights
author: Damir Sadikov
description:
Detects processes opening a handle to lsass.exe with access masks commonly
used by credential dumping tools such as Mimikatz, procdump and
comsvcs.dll MiniDump. LSASS holds cached credentials in memory, so a
non-system process requesting read/clone rights to it is a high-fidelity
indicator of OS credential dumping.
